primitives.meaning: a selection is recorded against the person in the system of record without a process being started
entryFilters: the identity behind the selection resolves to a person we may contact
the selection holds at least one item the platform currently asserts as available
the selection has not been carried into a process, and no process is open for its items
no recovery instance is already open for this selection
purpose-level permission for commercial recovery communication is recorded, and hard gates (GLB-31) allow it

primitives.asks: Can this selection be recovered for this person at all?

branches.label: Eligible
branches.observes: selection state, identity resolution, permission record
branches.test: the identity resolves to a contactable person, at least one item is available, no process is open for the items, no instance is open for this selection, and commercial recovery permission is recorded

branches.label: Not eligible
branches.observes: selection state, identity resolution, permission record
branches.test: any of those fails - the reason is recorded as the no-action reason

primitives.does: Open the recovery instance against the selection and start the clock from the last activity on it. Activity before the first touch moves the clock; nothing after the first touch extends any window

cancelOn.meaning: an order or completion is recorded that includes at least one item from the selection
every item was removed from the selection by the person, or the selection was deleted
an authoritative record that a resumable process (checkout, application, quote, registration) opened for a person with at least one item and a resumable state
an item was added to or removed from the selection while at least one item remains

primitives.reads: the selection re-read from the system of record: items present, each item's availability and price as the platform asserts them, no order placed, no process opened

branches.label: Converted
branches.test: an order including any item from the selection is recorded

branches.label: Cleared
branches.test: the person removed every item or deleted the selection

branches.label: Carried into a process
branches.test: a process was started from the selection

branches.label: Changed, still held
branches.test: an item was added or removed and at least one remains - the person is still deciding

branches.label: Still held
branches.test: the selection stands as it was

primitives.does: Record the change and re-arm the first wait from the new last activity, a bounded number of times. A person still editing a selection is deciding, not forgetting

primitives.asks: Can any of it still be acted on?

branches.label: At least one item available
branches.test: the platform asserts at least one selected item as available

branches.label: Nothing available
branches.test: the platform asserts every selected item as unavailable

primitives.asks: May the first touch go out?

branches.label: Sendable
branches.test: the send path passes: permission for commercial recovery, a deliverable destination, the promotional pressure cap, no higher-precedence contest on the person, and no cooldown in force

branches.label: Suppressed
branches.test: a gate stops it; the gate is recorded as the reason

primitives.does: Record which gate stopped the touch and against which selection, so no-action is a measured outcome rather than a silent absence

competition.precedence: below process recovery - a process in motion outranks a held selection; above interest recovery and predicted-need replenishment for the same person

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: an app session or a valid push token exists for this person - the selection is recent and a nudge back beats content
no low-friction route exists, or the touch has to carry the items as they stand and survive until the person can act

primitives.purpose: The selection as it currently stands - only the items still available - and the link that reopens it. Nothing the system does not assert.
primitives.brief: Show the selection as it stands now - only the items the platform asserts as available - and give the link that reopens it. Claim nothing the system does not assert: no reserved stock, no held price, no discount, no expiry

primitives.state: cleared by the person; nothing further is sent
primitives.reEntry: a new selection is a new instance

primitives.state: every selected item unavailable; nothing is sent about items that cannot be acted on
primitives.reEntry: availability restored is an authoritative event for a later availability journey, not a re-entry here

primitives.state: no touch sent; the gate that stopped it is recorded
primitives.reEntry: a new selection is a new instance, subject to the cooldown when this one lapsed or was suppressed

primitives.state: recovery lifetime passed with the selection still held; nothing further is sent
primitives.reEntry: a new selection is a new instance, and enters silently while the cooldown runs

primitives.on: a process started from the selection - the process owns recovery from that moment
carries: the recovery touches already sent for the selection, so the process plan counts them against the person
suppresses: every queued recovery touch for this selection
